evals.prompt: I need a codename for this feature branch, something cool and memorable
evals.expected_output: Uses phrase or thematic strategy, returns a name

evals.prompt: Generate 5 names for our new k8s namespaces, they should all be from the same theme
evals.expected_output: Uses --category with a single theme, returns 5 themed names

evals.prompt: I want a deterministic friendly name for commit SHA abc123f so I can refer to it in standups
evals.expected_output: Uses mnemonic strategy with --input abc123f, returns stable word pair

evals.prompt: Give me 5 alliterative two-word names for our microservices, they should sound catchy
evals.expected_output: Uses --strategy phrase:alliterative, most outputs share first letter (fallback to non-alliterative after 50 retries)

evals.prompt: I need a three-word codename for our Q3 release, something epic sounding
evals.expected_output: Uses --strategy triple, returns a three-word hyphenated name

evals.prompt: Name 3 servers using a volcano theme
I have this long deployment ID 0xdeadbeefcafebabe and want a memorable alias for it
evals.expected_output: Uses mnemonic with long hex input, returns a three-word name
